args.prompt:
Create ONE new KFB Slop character asset sheet,1536x1024landscape,precisely SIX UNIQUE expressive surreal-weird cartoon claymation INK BLOB MONSTERS in3columns x2rows, TRUE transparent PNG. Series "Small Openings": relief, warmth and uncertain social contact. SIMPLE ordinary apartment residents/passersby, light low-tier/NPC equipment, not soldiers, bosses, human-costumed heroes or conceptual contraptions. Strong emotional acting at the peak of a reaction, warm dry satire. Each stands alone.
INPUTS: image1 ORIGINAL STYLE reference for thick whole rounded body,tactile plasticine,lids and craft;image2 ORIGINAL family goo/splat morphology, NOT its repeated angry grins. These are STYLE references not edit targets; new actors not costume copies, no generated style parent.
ACCEPTED GENTLE MATERIAL LOCK: Same soft rounded rich modeled stop-motion plasticine, fine fingerprints, soft upper-left studio light and restrained satin highlights. Only slight charcoal-black ink bias versus source;subtle deep plum undertone retained. NO further aggressive blackening or flattened volume. Avoid white/lavender rim-glow, coarse gritty angular clay,fuzzy felt fibre weave on goo,glossy vinyl or polished Pixar-style human faces. Cloth/wood/brass props tactile and coherent. Lips DARK body-colored ink,not pink lipstick.
ANATOMY: EACH one complete continuous UPRIGHT FOOTLESS ink blob, asymmetrical soft rounded drooping lobes and short ink hands. Big face in body;small sparse domestic accessories,body dominant. No human torso,legs,shoes,feet,severed bust,lying,seated or puddle-only pose. All eyes have WHITE/IVORY sclera around RED iris and BLACK pupil,thick fully filled dark clay lids. No red glowing eyeballs. Any teeth descend from upper gum INSIDE mouth;closed mouths toothless, no tooth glued outside lower lip.
COMPOSITION: Landscape3x2equal cells, six equally prominent LARGE figures. Same apparent body scale in both rows;no shrinking cringing characters. Each entire silhouette includingall props/droplets comfortably occupies about84% owncell height with at least24px clear transparent safe margin on allsides. No overlaps, shared objects, cross-cell interactions,cropped edges,scenelets,floor,shadowdiscs,labels,writing,watermark or gridlines. White eye/acting readable at96px. Exactly TWO female-read designs per sheet as specified, subtly lashes/styling, no human anatomy. Distinguish silhouettes/eyes/mouth/poses BEFOREprops. No automatic grins, repeated V-brows,O-mouth slot or bottom-right tongue.
READING ORDER left-right top-bottom:
1. RELIEVED: Female-read tall soft droopy bell ink blob, modest lashes and small faded teal scarf. One hand loosens scarf, other holds single small ivory handkerchief near chest. Half-open white eyes look upward, eyebrows released unevenly, mouth crooked OPEN laughing exhale with two upper teeth and no tongue. Body opens outward in relief while upright. Clearly different from ecstatic joy.
2. GRATEFUL: Male-read squat wide round blob with one curled central crest. Both ink hands clasp ONE tiny wooden clothespin to his heart as an unexpectedly precious favour. Huge soft white eyes looking toward camera, inner brows lifted, small CLOSED uneven touched smile. Tiny forward inclination but upright full-size, no kneeling, no human coat. Gratitude, not bashful flirtation.
3. AWKWARDLY DELIGHTED: Male-read broad crooked triangular splat with little crooked muted orange paper party cone atop one short crest. Both ink hands suspended mid-clap separated by visible gap, shy shoulders slightly raised. Asymmetrical white eyes wide with nervous delight, one raised brow, OPEN broad lop-sided grin with four widely irregular upper teeth. Eager awkward joy, no confetti or balloon props.
4. GUARDEDLY HOPEFUL: Female-read upright reverse-comma ink blob, low swept inkquiff, modest lashes and small dusty rose collar. One hand holds a tiny green sprig close, other palm half opens as if testing an offer without handing anything across cells. White eyes raised toward camera with one cautious narrowed lid and other bright open, mouth CLOSED hesitant upturn with worried other corner. Tentative hope, no fantasy costume.
5. EMBARRASSED: Male-read chubby pear-shaped blob with three small uneven crest nubs, otherwise bare goo. One hand awkwardly conceals one small unmatched faded blue sock behind his OWN side, other rubs back of crest. White eyes sidelong down, brows lifted at unequal heights, CLOSED crooked compressed mouth trying to whistle but no pink lips. Mortified caught-out posture, still upright and large, no blush overlays.
6. COMPASSIONATE CONCERN: Male-read broad rounded low-crest goo blob, holding one little folded ochre blanket securely in one hand against body. Other hand makes a low reassuring open palm toward camera without interaction with neighboring cells. Half-open white eyes, raised inner brows, CLOSED small patient crooked smile. Upright with gentle forward attention, not tragic crying, no halo or nurse uniform.
Make these ordinary residents emotionally visceral and expressive, offbeat relatable clay ink creatures. Humble props few and readable;the reaction is the identity. All image lettering absent; English names live only in metadata. Preserve rounded whole ink identity and craftsmanship.
